//==
// # Constrained programs
//
// Optimization problems stated as matrices and bounds: linear and quadratic
// programs and the constraint relation they share. Rows of a constraint
// matrix are indexed by constraint, columns by variable; bounds run per
// variable. The goals, stopping rules, and results these problems are solved
// against live in the first section above.

// How a constraint row relates its left side to its right side.
// (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Constraint_(mathematics))
type ConstraintRelation = Equality | LessOrEqual | GreaterOrEqual;
